notes.title: v1.0.8 Testing Testing
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters!

We are back with a small but special update. It transpired we never wired up the final secret achievement of the game to anything, so no one was able to unlock it.

So we took this opportunity to do a small special thing for those dedicated enough to stick with us all this time, as a thank you for supporting us :)

Let's see if you can find the last achievement and enjoy the added 'thing'!

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: v1.0.7 The Framerater
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters! This is a small update to address one point:

- Updated the framerate set specifically for the charts/notes scrolling on the screen. It didn't match the rest of the screen's refresh rate. It should be a tiny tiny bit smoother now!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Sprytosaur Games is at Gamescom Asia 2022!
notes.notes:
Hello!

notes.title: v1.0.6 The Button Balancer
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters! Today we are sharing the following changes:
- There was a sensitivity issue when using the gamepad/game controller's face buttons which caused cooldown to trigger early. This has now been resolved.
- "The Progressor" is now achievable. If you have played over 20 songs already, this will unlock at the end of your next song completion.

Please also note, as a result of game balancing to get a score on the leaderboard, those who have recorded a score on release v1.0.0 will have their leaderboard scores reset. This affects an extremely minimal amount of players as this was a short-lived release before v1.0.1, so do not panic!

Happy Gaming!

Pro tip: If you do not have a touchscreen, you can also attain the "Classic ThumBeater" achievement with a mouse.

notes.title: v1.0.5 (More) Achievements Unlocked!
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters! Today's update brings you the following:
- Leaderboards will now show up to 20 entries in any given filter, provided there are at least 20 entries to display. Use the scrollbar with a mouse/touchscreen or up/down arrows on a keyboard/gamepad to navigate through them!
- Leaderboards screen will also now highlight which current filter is being applied. This should help indicate what version of the leaderboard you are looking at
- Despite your awesome efforts to aim for some of the harder achievements, they remained locked. Sorry! Please try again and they should now unnlock :)

Happy gaming!

Pro tip: Did you know that you can also press F5 on a keyboard to refresh the leaderboard? We felt like it was the right thing to do.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Korean and Overlays Updates
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters! We are here today to fine tune two experiences:
- We have updated the Korean localisation to use more consistent languages across the game
- An issue was reported when bringing up the Steam Overlay whilst the game is counting down to start. This has now been resolved.

See you at the next one!

notes.title: v1.0.3 The Power of the Mouse
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters! We are back with some small quality-of-life updates for you:
- Fixed controls with mouse and touchscreen where some menu items were not pressing properly
- Made it clearer when the mouse is overing over a clickable element in some instances
- Occasionally, when using a mouse or toushcreen, the game might play in a difficulty you did not select. This has been resolved.
- Other minor UI consistency improvements, here and there.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: v1.0.2 The Cooldown Continues
notes.notes:
Hello ThumBeaters! This is a small update to build on top of what we released previously:
- We adjusted the experience for left-handed mouse users as it wasn't quite right
- We adjusted the scoring experience for mouse and touchscreen users to ensure you don't accidentally enter 'Cooldown' prematurely

That's all for now, see you at the next one!

notes.title: Welcome to ThumBeat: Button Basher Edition! v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for being here! We are excited to get you all button bashing away at some new songs never seen before in rhythm games.

But speaking of button bashing, we have just pushed out an update to do some fixes you have kindly shared back with us:
- Push & Shove on Easy was not working, and selecting it takes you to a broken game screen. This should be playable now.
- If you are using a mouse or touch screen on the Pause screen, you weren't able to resume. This should be working as expected now.
- Despite the game's name, we need to make sure you are not literally just mashing the controls all the way through! We have added a mechanism to ensure genuine gameplay and thus has more genuine high scores on the leaderboards.

Thank you for reading this, and Happy Button Bashing!
